title: feat: add Recraft V4.1 Flash via OpenRouter
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Adds `recraft/recraft-v4.1-flash`, a text-to-image model, via OpenRouter's `/api/v1/images` endpoint
- Pinned to the `recraft` provider with `allow_fallbacks: false`; it is the only endpoint OpenRouter lists, so no fallback is declared
- Fixed `$0.007` per output image (registry cost `0.007 * 1.055`, including the 5.5% OpenRouter credit fee), metered as one `completionImageTokens` like `recraft-v4.1-vector`
- Text input only. The live endpoint returns WebP (docs say PNG), so both are accepted. Supports `1:1`, `4:3`, `3:4`, `16:9`, `9:16`. An explicit `aspectRatio` is honored (`adaptive` maps to `auto`, unsupported values return 400); otherwise the nearest ratio to width/height is used

## Live verification (2026-09-23, direct OpenRouter, pinned to `recraft`)
- `16:9` returned 1344x768 and `auto` returned 1024x1024, both HTTP 200 with `media_type: image/webp`
- Billed `usage.cost` was exactly `$0.007` for 4,175 image tokens per image, matching the registry rate before the 5.5% fee
- This probe caught the docs-vs-live mismatch: a PNG-only check would have rejected every response

## Test plan
- [x] Handler tests: pinned provider and fixed fee, aspect-ratio resolution, unsupported ratio rejected before the request, WebP and PNG accepted, other media types rejected, content-policy rejection
- [x] Effective-price snapshot entry
- [x] `npx biome check --write` on changed files; no `tsc` errors in the touched files
- [ ] CI (local Vitest/Miniflare fails to start in this environment for unrelated reasons)
- [ ] Maintainer gateway run to reconcile wallet debit and the billed Tinybird event

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)


Fixes #15416

gist.headline: A Flash of Recraft
gist.blurb: The image garden picked up Recraft V4.1 Flash through OpenRouter. Polli checked the return package twice: it may arrive as WebP, and that is perfectly welcome here.
gist.summary: Added the text-to-image model `recraft/recraft-v4.1-flash` through OpenRouter’s `/api/v1/images` endpoint, pinned to the Recraft provider with no fallbacks, at a fixed $0.007 per generated image before the 5.5% OpenRouter credit fee.
gist.impact: Developers can now generate Recraft V4.1 Flash images with text prompts, supported ratios from 1:1 to 9:16, explicit `aspectRatio` handling, and acceptance of both live WebP and documented PNG responses.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Recraft V4.1 Flash as a cozy little image-making workshop: a retro terminal routes a text prompt into a bright framed pixel landscape, with small WebP and PNG picture cards both accepted on a workbench. Polli, wearing a tiny painter’s beret, inspects the two finished formats with warm approval; code-plants and ratio-shaped flower frames (square, landscape, portrait) make the model’s supported output shapes visible.
